gbm_population_evidence.quote: Patients with pathological diagnosis of glioblastoma at first surgery (WHO Grade IV, supratentorial location);

candidate_evidence.quote: Patients wear two pairs of electrodes on the head for 19-22 hours a day.
All patients will receive Tumor Electric Fields Treatment System.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: With imaging or pathological evidence of tumor recurrence;

coder_notes: Early Phase 1 device-only trial (tumour treating fields, ASCLU-300) in recurrent GBM. No drug or biologic intervention, so agents is empty and the trial has no pharmacological candidate (device = excluded intervention type). 'WHO Grade IV' without a WHO edition or IDH requirement -> cns5_terminology unclear.
